summary: Moonlight 6.2 streams at 1080p by default on new installs, adds VRR on Nvidia GPUs, AV1 hardware decoding on M3 and later Macs, and DualSense adaptive triggers. It fixes flaws that let a bad host crash Moonlight, and no longer captures the cursor in windowed mode until you click. Portable Windows users updating in place must delete tls\qopensslbackend.dll.
